proposed_widenings.name: open_planar_portal
proposed_widenings.justification: Gate creates a persistent, bidirectional circular portal between planes — creatures on either side can walk through it. `transport_exile` is directional (one-way send), making it semantically wrong for a portal. A new atom is needed for 'create a traversable passage to another plane while concentration holds.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellTargetRestriction.face_keyed_plane
proposed_widenings.justification: The cube's six faces are each assigned to a specific plane at item-creation time. Pressing a face constrains the destination to that face's plane — a closed set of up to 6 DM-determined options, not freely chosen from all planes. No existing GrantedSpellTargetRestriction variant captures 'destination locked to one of N pre-assigned item-face options.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the GM.

notes: The charge-pool / dawn-recharge / magic-action frame fits ActivatedAbilityMechanics cleanly. Plane Shift could be partially encoded as `transport_exile` with `destination: 'different_plane'`, missing only the face-plane constraint. Gate has no honest atom — `transport_exile` is directional exile, not portal creation. Because Gate is half the item's mechanical payload, a complete honest encoding is impossible without the new atom. No dhall/json produced.
